result.summary: Wrote lib/letflow/design/req517-scoped-grants-admin-plane.md (design only, no implementation code). Covers both PRs: 2a grant admin plane (route inventory pinned in one table, ScopedGrants service over new low-level RoleScopeGrants functions, lock order A, R, N, B, C, FK migration with precheck, test-side :down ordering, retire guard, tenant-wide versus scoped rule, last-row refusal, zero-admin guard, self-grant and self-add refusal, audit event table, admin-flagged service principal with mint target-side relaxation only, single-writer mix scan with must-pass fixtures) and 2b route plane (scope option on the authz macros plus admin-plane key table plus committed default snapshot, stored on value with CHECK widening and unsettable parse_mode, Authorize enforcement under on, retired node unresolvable, fail-closed error path, attachment link audit, persisted shadow counters with ETS and a flush GenServer). Every one of the 23 ACs maps to a design element, tests (over 100 test rows, some ids cover ranges) and mutants (17 for 2a, 15 for 2b). No new permission atom: the permission-matrix golden is unchanged. Findings against the requirement text: F1 AC 8 revoke guard cannot fire with the existing admin count (zero-row binding still counted), so a new explicit count is designed; F2 the AC 5 retire side must lock the node row before it reads references_node?, or a create and a retire can interleave; F3 TenantAdminGuard.resource_type has no clause for the new actions (audit would be lost silently); F4 get_mode guard would 500 for a stored on; F5 stage-1 route-walk tests T-RW1b and T-RW1c also break and are edited; F6 unclassified versus default tenant_wide resolved by a committed snapshot; F7 Infrastructure child count test 24 to 25; F9 flag route must check credential oidc explicitly; F10 self-service routes have no class under on. REVISION r1 (CDV FAIL D1-D4, SEC FAIL D-1/D-2/D-3 applied in place): manifest anchor fixed to the 20_261_016_120_001 entry with exact 2a and 2b entries; read signatures and owning modules added (Identity read functions plus RoleScopeGrants.effective?); route_row and error types defined; T-G1 committed fixture, enforce-denied telemetry observable, ShadowEvidence async false with shared sandbox, counts_between reads the table only; new 409 last_admin_binding_row refuses deleting the only row of a group TENANT_ADMIN set (lockout unreachable), counted and explicit counts agree (T-Z7); flush binds the schema via insert_all prefix after validator, hostile keys dropped; credential in grant and service_principal audit payloads; requirement amendments RA-1..RA-5 and gate rulings in section 16.
open_questions: OQ-1 AC 8 revoke_tenant_admin_grant cannot fire with count_tenant_wide_admins (zero-row binding still counted). Default: new count_explicit_tenant_wide_admins for that action; existing count for scope_tenant_admin.
OQ-2 AC 17 unclassified fails versus default tenant_wide. Default: three sources (declared, key table, default) plus a committed snapshot of default-sourced routes; runtime fail closed.
OQ-3 Self-service routes (/me, /help) are 403 for scoped-only users under on; no class exists. Default: stay tenant_wide, listed in the PR body; follow-up class needed.
OQ-4 Platform-tenant PLATFORM_ADMIN on the service principal route. Default: refused, TENANT_ADMIN role holders only.
OQ-6 Enforce DB error answer. Default: 500 detail-free, never allow.
OQ-15 RESOLVED by SECURITY: token principals may call grant write routes; flag route OIDC-only.
OQ-3 ACCEPTED for 2b; REQ-519 flip blocked until a self-service route class exists (RA-3).
